name: Marlo foreshore & jetty
how: Fish around the jetty pylons from late afternoon into dark. Cast lightly weighted baits or small plastics along the edge where the bank drops into the channel.
getThere: Walk in from the town foreshore. Easiest spot for families and anyone without a boat.

name: Main basin sand flats
how: Drift the edges of the bars on a moving tide and work plastics down the drop-off into the deeper channel.
getThere: Launch at the Beach Road ramp. The flats are a short run east across the basin.

name: Snowy River entrance
how: Fish the channel edges just inside the mouth late in the run-in. Anchor well back from the bar and keep watching the swell.
getThere: Boat only, in calm conditions. Never cross the bar.

name: Ocean beach east of the mouth
how: Pick a gutter: a band of darker, deeper water between the sandbank and the shore, ideally with a rip running out. Cast just past the first line of breakers.
getThere: Beach tracks east of town. Exact track names and parking still to confirm.

name: Snowy River, upstream channel
how: Work snags and undercut banks on the bends with slow lures fished close to cover.
getThere: From the ramp, head upriver past the town foreshore.
